correctness.rationale: Under unit-sum two-candidate utilities, the intersection of both reports partitions x into the reflected mesh. The midpoint rule achieves (1+w)/(1-w) for every n; two voters in a maximum-width cell and its reflection force the same value. At most 2t+1 cells imply w>=1/(2t+1), with equality iff all reflected cuts are uniform. All boundary conventions addressed by limits. Standalone Fraction checker passed 57,568 assertions for 639 threshold sets; infinite proof is analytical.
